0.text: Nice to see you again $NAME. It’s been a while hasn’t it? I expect you must be excited! A Highsteppe Guardian!

1.text: Such a great honor for a person of your station. I apologize for not coming to see your final trials - I’ve been caught up in the preparations for this festival…

0.text: Yes! Our new Bishop requires the finest of things. Including a venue. The main tent still needs to be set up, and I’m lacking in  hands and time to collect all the bits and pieces needed.

1.text: We require rope, pegs and a hammer to put it all together. Have a look around and see if you can find those things for me would you?

0.text: Thank you $NAME. You can begin your search near Cenn's farm and around the Market place, the kids of the village tend to carry off these parts for their little games.
It’s done? You’ve all the pieces? Why, you’ve saved my neck $NAME. I would have never lived it down if we didn't have everything set up in time for Bishop Roma’s speech.

2.text: The speech is about to begin, we best go see what the Bishop has to say.

4.text: Rebels...Trying to kill the Bishop? Unbelievable?
